name: Finolex Cables Ltd
title: Finolex Cables Ltd - 500144 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Electrical volumes and pricing strong (~14 upward price changes, 24-25% effective), while OFC preform capacity only just commissioned and fixed-price contracts delay benefit; FY26 segment EBIT ~6% with no guidance given.

utilisation.quote: There is a headroom, 66% is where we're operating so about 15% headroom is still available.

capex.peers_comment: Competitors have started adding vertical insulation capacity for EHV JV technology.
capex.quote: we are going to double the line there and that would be helpful for us

triggers.label: Effective price change ~24-25%
triggers.quote: the effective price change at the market was about 24%-25% in most of the SKUs, this is on electrical.

triggers.label: Capex ~INR 300 cr incl. INR 200 cr new
triggers.quote: out of which INR 200 crores is completely new, which is for capacity enhancements.

triggers.label: OFC draw utilisation ~3.2 of 4 mn km
triggers.quote: It'll be about 3.2 out of the 4.

triggers.label: Inventory up ~INR 300 cr pre-buying
triggers.quote: the inventory is up by about INR 300-odd crores, so part of that investment has gone in there.

triggers.label: No numeric guidance given
triggers.quote: I actually do not give out any guidance, especially in a situation like today

guidance.value: should do better than ~6%, no number
guidance.quote: I think we should do better than that.
I actually do not give out any guidance, especially in a situation like today

prior_guidance_check.quote: I think we should do better than that.

red_flags.label: Germanium/glass supply constraints and export restrictions
red_flags.quote: There is no fiber to be had anywhere in the world

red_flags.label: Fixed-price contract lag on OFC pricing
red_flags.quote: until those contracts run out, we will not see the benefit coming into our financials

red_flags.label: Retail housing-wire demand hit by price rises
red_flags.quote: The retail one where you go to the hardware market or the electrical market and where the distributor is selling it or the dealer is selling it, that has taken a hit.

evasions.quote: At this point in time, I'm not able to really commit to a number or even predict a number
I'm not going to put my neck out there. I do not know how to predict that part.
I don't have that number in front of me.
